rows: Which kinds of entities and functions participate; whether an object represents a performer, part, ensemble, instruction, or organizing structure
Relative position, exact ratios, generational level, and the reference from which those positions are measured
Generation, succession, separation, inheritance, opposition, restoration, and other changes—without treating them as interchangeable
Entry, duration, order, overlap, recurrence, cessation, and conditions permitting an event
Which relationships govern or coordinate others, and how authority changes without necessarily changing the underlying reference
What actually occurred, what was merely instructed or anticipated, and what accumulated across the sequence

| **Orchestration and authority** | Which relationships govern or coordinate others, and how authority changes without necessarily changing the underlying reference                  |
